d: Build a career rich with potential.

Some careers grow faster than others. If you’re looking for a role that offers opportunities to develop, broaden your experience and take your career in an exciting new direction, join HSBC. We provide opportunities, support and rewards to help you take your career further.

This position sits within HSBC Markets Treasury (MKTY), the street-facing arm of the Treasury function. MKTY is responsible for managing cash, funding, liquidity and interest rate risks that underpin HSBC Oman’s objective of achieving profitability. You will play a pivotal role in delivering Markets Treasury initiatives within the Oman market, while ensuring that the business operates within its agreed risk appetite and in full compliance with HSBC Group and regulatory requirements.
q: Strong business and financial markets knowledge is required.
Commercially driven and the ability work under dynamic market conditions will be an advantage.
Knowledge of technology development and infrastructure, including how technology can be used to meet business needs.
Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with colleagues and senior management.
The ability to manage and mitigate operational risk effectively.
Experience working in a diverse and geographically dispersed team.
Knowledge of the external environment, including regulatory, political, competitor and market developments would be an advantage.
Priority will be given to Omani Nationals.

At HSBC, you’ll work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are valued. You’ll have the opportunity to work across borders, develop your expertise and contribute to a business that connects clients and markets across the region and globally.
If you’re ready to take responsibility, get things done and help shape the future of Markets Treasury, we’d like to hear from you.
r: Managing cash to ensure surplus funds are deployed and deficits are financed on the best available terms for the bank.
Executing and completing short- and medium-term funding plans on behalf of the bank and entity.
Managing liquidity to ensure the bank or entity can meet its current and potential cash-flow obligations at a reasonable cost, without incurring significant commercial or reputational risk.
Managing the entity’s Liquid Asset Buffer (LAB) within the risk appetite defined by the LAB Committee, ensuring it remains available for monetisation during stress scenarios.
Hedging / Managing interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) using Financial Markets instruments.
Supporting the development and maintenance of effective governance structures, processes and controls that meet HSBC Group standards.

Supporting delivery of the annual Global Performance Scorecard, including financial targets such as revenue, costs and risk-weighted assets, as well as non-financial obligations relating to liquidity risk management, conduct and operational risk.
Ensuring the business operates within agreed risk appetite and complies fully with Group policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
Championing transformation and change initiatives, from execution through to effective embedding across the business.
Undertaking analytics and providing accurate, timely data to support informed decision-making.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. d: We are seeking a proactive and tech-savvy IT Support Engineer to provide exceptional technical assistance and ensure the smooth operation of our daily IT functions. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for hardware, software, and network troubleshooting, dedicated to delivering a seamless technology experience for our employees from their first day onward.

As part of a forward-thinking IT team, you will do more than just resolve day-to-day issues. We are looking for someone who is passionate about continuous improvement and eager to leverage AI and automation to streamline processes, improve ticketing efficiency, and enhance overall productivity across the organisation.
q: Relevant Background: Proven experience in a standalone or primary IT support role within a modern office environment.
Regulated Environments: Proven experience in working in regulated environments: Frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS), Regulators (CBUAE, DFSA, VARA, etc.)
Core Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with Jamf, Asset Management, Jira, Okta, and Google Workspace.
Fleet: Hands-on experience managing Apple hardware and software.
Network & Infrastructure Skills: Practical experience patching, maintaining, and troubleshooting local office networks, alongside managing ISP relationships.
AV Troubleshooting: Experience managing AV systems and conference room tech.
Local Procurement: Familiarity with local IT procurement in the UAE and navigating regional hardware vendors.
Supplier Liaison Skills: Strong communication and vendor management skills (prior experience dealing with UAE ISPs like Etisalat is a massive plus).
Autonomy & Reliability: Ability to work independently, manage your own time flexibly, and act as the approachable, reliable face of IT for the Dubai team.
Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; Arabic is a bonus.
Certifications: Certifications such as, CompTIA Network+, or Jamf Pro (100/200) are highly desirable.
r: IT Helpdesk & Ticketing: Manage day-to-day CorporateIT support using our Jira Service Management (JSM) ticketing system.
SaaS Access Management: Manage access to the organization’s SaaS
Device & Asset Management: Serve as an admin for our MDM (Jamf) and maintain a meticulous, up-to-date hardware inventory using our asset management tool (Bluetally).

Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the end-to-end technical lifecycle for Dubai employees. This includes procuring laptops, configuring hardware/software, provisioning accounts, and ensuring a seamless, automated experience.
AV & Collaboration Systems: Manage, troubleshoot, and maintain all Audio/Visual (AV) and video conferencing systems in the Dubai office to ensure flawless internal and external meetings.
Vendor & Supplier Relations: Engage with and maintain strong, productive relationships with local hardware and software suppliers.

Network & ISP Management: Fully manage, patch, and maintain our local office network. You will be responsible for hands-on network troubleshooting to quickly resolve any infrastructure issues, while also acting as the primary liaison with Etisalat for internet services—navigating outages and negotiating plan upgrades.
Documentation: Create and maintain clear internal IT documentation, runbooks, and self-service guides for employees.
